verification.label: API and frontend tests
verification.detail: API: 4 files, 68 tests; frontend: 1 file, 3 tests. All passed using an in-memory SQLite database.

verification.detail: 27/27 checks: in-class 23/23, challenge 4/4. Covers hashing, JWT, 401/403, validation, production secret requirement, security header and login rate limiting.
